resources: ShareScreen ' Back Cancel ' Share a screen. Watch it anywhere. Show your screen, with sound, to a friend on your Wi-Fi or across the world. How it works Devices on the same Wi-Fi find each other; for anyone else, send an invite link. Picture and sound go straight between the devices, encrypted. You approve every viewer, and every request to control your device.
